instruction:
Software launch locations: LibreCAD: `/usr/bin/librecad`; FreeCAD: `/usr/bin/freecad`; KiCad: `/home/user/Applications/kicad-10.0.2/kicad-10.0.2-x86_64.AppImage`; Blender: `/home/user/Applications/blender-4.2.3-linux-x64/blender`. Required four-software transfer workflow: LibreCAD -> FreeCAD -> KiCad -> Blender. Start from the provided seed DXF /home/user/Desktop/seed_optical_gate_fixture.dxf; do not start from a blank or unrelated drawing. This is a chained workflow: every later stage must read an artifact from the previous stage, and every required intermediate file must be saved on the Desktop. The design token for this task is EW4G10; keep this token visible in the DXF labels and KiCad silkscreen. The Blender output must visibly consume the stage-2 STL and stage-3 SVG through Blender's native import/export operations.

Design goal: U-shaped optical gate fixture with emitter and receiver alignment. This case is intentionally different from the other benchmark cases: domain=optical_alignment_fixture, mechanical target=a U-fixture scene showing emitter and receiver pockets connected by a red beam path, electronics target=an optical-gate PCB with IR emitter, phototransistor, sync connector, gain trimmer, and test pads.

1. LibreCAD stage: open the provided seed file /home/user/Desktop/seed_optical_gate_fixture.dxf in LibreCAD, use it as the starting drawing, complete the required 2D geometry, remove all GUIDE construction entities, and save /home/user/Desktop/stage1_optical_gate_fixture.dxf. Use millimeters. Use layers OUTLINE, BEAM_SLOT, HOLE, LABEL. The overall drawing envelope must be 135 mm x 85 mm. Include the required circular features: center (12,12) radius 2.4; center (123,12) radius 2.4; center (12,73) radius 2.4; center (123,73) radius 2.4; center (35,42.5) radius 3; center (100,42.5) radius 3. Add readable labels EW4G10, EMITTER, RECEIVER, ALIGN on the LABEL layer.
2. FreeCAD stage: import /home/user/Desktop/stage1_optical_gate_fixture.dxf in FreeCAD. Create the 3D mechanical body from that LibreCAD DXF, and export the body as /home/user/Desktop/stage2_optical_gate_fixture.stl with an approximate bounding size of 135 mm x 85 mm x 32 mm. Then, from the same FreeCAD model, export a top-face or board-interface outline for KiCad as /home/user/Desktop/stage2_optical_gate_fixture_handoff_outline.dxf. This handoff DXF must represent the same XY envelope as the FreeCAD body and include the visible labels FREECAD_TO_KICAD and EW4G10.
3. KiCad stage: open KiCad, create a PCB from /home/user/Desktop/stage2_optical_gate_fixture_handoff_outline.dxf by importing the handoff DXF as the Edge.Cuts board outline, and save the KiCad board as /home/user/Desktop/stage3_optical_gate_fixture_board.kicad_pcb. Add F.SilkS silkscreen text carrying KICAD_TO_BLENDER, EDGE_FROM_STAGE2_HANDOFF, the stage2 handoff filename, EW4G10, and these board tokens: EW4G10, IR-D1, PHOTO-Q1, SYNC-J1, GAIN-RV1, TEST-TP1, TEST-TP2. Then use KiCad's plot/export workflow to create the Blender handoff SVG /home/user/Desktop/stage3_optical_gate_fixture_board_profile.svg from the same Edge.Cuts outline.
4. Blender stage: open Blender. Import /home/user/Desktop/stage2_optical_gate_fixture.stl with File > Import > STL, then import /home/user/Desktop/stage3_optical_gate_fixture_board_profile.svg with File > Import > Scalable Vector Graphics (.svg). Keep the imported STL body object and the imported SVG board/profile curves in the scene so the exported GLB carries Blender import evidence such as stage2_optical_gate_fixture and stage3_optical_gate_fixture_board_profile.svg. You may leave Blender's default cube/camera/light or remove them; do not manually inject handoff metadata. Export glTF Binary (.glb) as /home/user/Desktop/stage4_optical_gate_fixture.glb.

Required deliverables on the Desktop: /home/user/Desktop/stage1_optical_gate_fixture.dxf, /home/user/Desktop/stage2_optical_gate_fixture.stl, /home/user/Desktop/stage2_optical_gate_fixture_handoff_outline.dxf, /home/user/Desktop/stage3_optical_gate_fixture_board.kicad_pcb, /home/user/Desktop/stage3_optical_gate_fixture_board_profile.svg, /home/user/Desktop/stage4_optical_gate_fixture.glb.

[Software] Use LibreCAD first, then FreeCAD, then KiCad, then Blender. Do not skip stages, reorder stages, or recreate the final result in only one software package.
